guide.summary: Heritage museums, the Japanese Covered Bridge and craft villages, with breakfast cafés, dinners and resort bars checked against their own websites or Hoi An's heritage conservation centre.
guide.tip: The heritage centre's older museum pages list one closing day a month for each public museum (the 10th at Sa Huynh, the 15th at Trade Ceramics, the 20th at Folk Culture and the 25th at History and Culture), so confirm the current schedule before planning a museum morning.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: The heritage centre's older museum pages list a monthly closing day for each museum: the 10th at Sa Huynh Culture Museum, the 15th at the Museum of Trade Ceramics, the 20th at the Museum of Folk Culture and the 25th at the Hoi An Museum of History and Culture. Confirm these with the centre before you go.

toolkit.label: Tickets
toolkit.copy: The Museum of Trade Ceramics and Sa Huynh Culture Museum list a visit ticket among their rules, and the heritage centre asks you to buy a ticket for Tra Que Vegetable Village and Thanh Ha Pottery Village. Prices are not published on these pages.

toolkit.label: Booking
toolkit.copy: Little Faifo, Secret Garden and The Temple Restaurant & Lounge take table bookings through their own sites. Red Bean Hoi An's cooking classes take 2 to 10 guests, and its street-food buffet runs on Tuesdays only, 18:00 to 21:00.

toolkit.label: Rules
toolkit.copy: VinWonders Nam Hoi An prices adults from 140 cm in height, with child categories below that. Hoi An Memories Land says its show goes ahead in the rain and hands out free raincoats.

guide.dek: Confirm museum closing days with the heritage centre before you plan, and book dinners at Little Faifo or The Temple ahead through their own forms.
intro: Hoi An's public museums are run by the Hội An World Cultural Heritage Conservation Center, whose office shares 10B Tran Hung Dao with the Hoi An Museum of History and Culture. On Tran Phu, the Museum of Trade Ceramics at No. 80 and the Sa Huynh Culture Museum at No. 149 both say you need a visit ticket. The centre's older museum pages give hours of 7:00 to 21:00 and one closing day a month for each museum, the 10th at Sa Huynh, the 15th at Trade Ceramics, the 20th at Folk Culture and the 25th at History and Culture, so check the current schedule with the centre. The Japanese Covered Bridge stands where Nguyen Thi Minh Khai meets Tran Phu.

Beyond the old streets, the centre asks you to buy a visit ticket for Tra Que Vegetable Village, about 2.5 km north of the Ancient Town, and Thanh Ha Pottery Village in the Nam Dieu area. Red Bean Hoi An Restaurant runs a 09:00 to 14:00 cooking class that visits Tra Que and a local market for VND 785,000 per person; shorter market classes cost VND 625,000, for 2 to 10 guests. Hoi An Memories Land at 88 Tran Quang Khai says its show goes ahead in the rain, with free raincoats. VinWonders Nam Hoi An in Thang Binh opens 9:00 to 18:00 on weekdays, 19:00 at weekends.

For a slower morning, Reaching Out Teahouse at 131 Tran Phu opens from 8:00 to 20:00 daily and describes a space that invites quiet contemplation; its Vietnamese tea tasting set costs 155,000 VND. Hoi An Roastery's main branch at 135 Tran Phu opens 07:00 to 21:00 daily and lists a homemade buttery croissant, and a third branch sits at 84 Tran Cao Van in Cam Pho. At La Siesta Hoi An Resort, 132 Hung Vuong, La Siesta Coffee serves from 06:30. For lunch, Mango Mango at 45 Nguyen Phuc Chu and Mai Fish at 45 Nguyen Thi Minh Khai both open daily from 8:00.

Little Faifo at 66 Nguyen Thai Hoc serves from 11:00 to 22:00, with last orders at 21:30, and you can book a table online. Secret Garden, at the end of the alley beside 132 Tran Phu, opens from 8:00 to 23:00 and has its own reservation form. On Tuesdays, Red Bean Hoi An holds a street-food buffet from 18:00 to 21:00 at VND 450,000 with live traditional music. The Temple Restaurant & Lounge keeps its bar open from 11:00 to midnight. By Cua Dai Beach, Victoria Hoi An's L'Annam Restaurant and sea-view Faifo Bar open from 06:00 to 22:00.
summaryCards: Start at the Japanese Covered Bridge, then walk to the Museum of Trade Ceramics at 80 Tran Phu, after checking its current hours with the heritage centre.
Take tea at Reaching Out Teahouse from 8:00 or coffee at Hoi An Roastery on Tran Phu from 07:00, then browse Reaching Out Arts & Crafts next door.
Confirm the museums' monthly closing days with the heritage centre, and note that Red Bean's street-food buffet runs on Tuesdays only.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. Museum hours and monthly closing days come from the heritage conservation centre's own pages, which date from 2011 to 2015; the Museum of Folk Culture and History and Culture museum pages give closing days but no times, and no heritage ticket prices were published on the pages read. Tra Que and Thanh Ha are located only at village level. Hours were not published for Hoi An Memories Land, the Japanese Covered Bridge, Hoi An Roastery (84 Tran Cao Van) or the Tra Que and Thanh Ha villages; the Mango Hoi An and Secret Garden sites carry no 2026-dated content. VinWonders Nam Hoi An posted an operational notice dated 19 October 2026 that could not be read in full, and the park is in Thang Binh, outside Hoi An. The bakery list is thin: no stand-alone Hoi An bakery with a readable official site was found, so it rests on Hoi An Roastery's homemade croissant and a 2023 operator article on L'Annam's breakfast croissants. Sites that could not be read: Ms Vy's group (Morning Glory, Cargo Club) and Four Seasons The Nam Hai and Anantara (HTTP 403), Hotel Royal Hoi An, Cocobox and Dingo Deli (domains did not resolve), and Jack Tran Tours (redirect loop). Lune Center Hoi An published no venue address.
